verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only team-level analogs. Admins can choose which tools each team member may use (treg-docs-28), members sign in individually (treg-docs-29), and some catalog entries support connecting 'your own account' via OAuth (treg-docs-25, treg-docs-26). However, credentials are described as shared team keys injected server-side (treg-docs-8, treg-docs-27), and nothing shows per-end-user connected accounts or tokens for a platform's own customers. Missing for 10: per-end-user connected-account management, per-user scoped tokens bound to that user's credentials, multi-tenant credential isolation docs, independent corroboration.
